interpretation: The rejected Chirp shapes consistently slowed the ordinary variable-frequency path and were removed. The final ordinary variable loop is unchanged, while the equal-frequency/equal-positive-amplitude loop is prepared separately. Final paired variable-Chirp variation is small and shared-host-sensitive; no per-item speedup is attributed from a grouped median. Standard filter, Morse and short spectrogram row/column timings are near noise on this host. Explicit allocation/work reductions are independently verified by focused tests.

reviewCorrection: Independent review found admitted Float32Array overridden-length/proxy behavior differed in the integer-offset padding path. A red exact baseline regression and three frozen original-export cases now prove fallback to the original full traversal unless intrinsic native length matches. The final durable receipt re-bundles corrected sources; the prior durable receipt is retained as development evidence, not final source evidence.
